description: The oxygen machine needs repairs. Stop it or keep it running?
sourceDescription:
The machine that produces oxygen from water has developed a problem.
 A technician believes it will be necessary to shut it down for a few hours
 to perform maintenance.
imageCaption: An astronaut replaces a filter in the space station.
imageAlt: An astronaut replaces a filter in the space station.

left.label: Repair the machine
left.description: Shut down and perform maintenance. We are going to temporarily halt production to avoid a larger problem.
left.sourceResponse: Shut down and perform maintenance. We are going to temporarily halt production to avoid a larger problem.

right.label: Keep it running
right.description: Continue using the machine. Let’s try to keep production running while we monitor the sensors.
right.sourceResponse: Continue using the machine. Let’s try to keep production running while we monitor the sensors.

description: A dust storm is coming. Our solar panels will get less light!
sourceDescription:
The Martian sky is turning increasingly red. 
A massive dust storm is approaching the base!
The solar panels are beginning to receive less light, 
and the team must decide how to handle the situation.
imageCaption: A dust storm sweeps across Mars.
imageAlt: A dust storm sweeps across Mars.
sourceSideEffects: nerf energy generation 15%/8 sols // nerf energy generation 35%/8 sols
sourceNotes:
Chance de ocorrência de uma tempestade de areia -> 0,45%
Distribuição de probabilidade da duração -> 3 a 7 sóis - 60%
8 a 15 sóis - 30%
16 a 30 sóis - 8%
31 a 50 sóis - 2%

left.label: Save energy
left.description: Let's conserve energy until the storm passes.
left.sourceResponse: Let's conserve energy until the storm passes.

right.label: Keep working
right.description: We do not want to interrupt the experiments and activities at the base.
right.sourceResponse: We do not want to interrupt the experiments and activities at the base.

description: A solar storm is coming. Should the crew use the shelter?
sourceDescription:
The base’s instruments have detected significant activity on the Sun!
A solar storm could send dangerous particles hurtling toward Mars. 
The astronauts need to take cover! There is a special shelter inside 
the base, with reinforced walls to provide extra protection.
imageCaption: A bright eruption rises from the surface of the Sun.
imageAlt: A bright eruption rises from the surface of the Sun.

left.label: Use the shelter
left.description: We will temporarily suspend some activities and wait until the danger has passed.
left.sourceResponse: We will temporarily suspend some activities and wait until the danger has passed.

right.label: Keep working
right.description: The storm might not hit the region where we are directly.
right.sourceResponse: The storm might not hit the region where we are directly.

description: MOXIE can make oxygen from Martian air, but it needs power.
sourceDescription:
Good news! The equipment responsible for producing oxygen (MOXIE)
has managed to extract some of this gas from the Martian air.
The equipment is functioning, but it needs energy to keep working.
imageCaption: MOXIE equipment with pipes and cables.
imageAlt: MOXIE equipment with pipes and cables.
sourceNotes:
O experimento MOXIE demonstrou a produção de oxigênio a partir 
do CO₂ da atmosfera marciana. Entretanto, o MOXIE era um 
demonstrador tecnológico, não um equipamento dimensionado para 
abastecer uma tripulação. Ou seja, não se torna por enquanto muito 
útil como fonte de oxigênio.

left.label: Make more oxygen
left.description: Let’s take this opportunity to produce more oxygen.
left.sourceResponse: Let’s take this opportunity to produce more oxygen.

right.label: Stop for now
right.description: We have already produced a sufficient amount for now.
right.sourceResponse: We have already produced a sufficient amount for now.

description: A pipe is leaking! Fix it now or save energy and wait?
sourceDescription:
One of the astronauts noticed that the water tank was emptying faster than it should.
After an inspection, the crew discovered a small leak in a pipe!
imageCaption: An astronaut works on pipes inside the space station.
imageAlt: An astronaut works on pipes inside the space station.
sourceNotes:
Em análises feitas sobre o sistema térmico Orion, por mais que ocorresse
o vazamento, o impacto não seria tão grande quanto ao valor salvo pelo 
conserto.

left.label: Fix the leak
left.description: We will need to expend energy and use some replacement parts, but we will avoid losing any more water.
left.sourceResponse: We will need to expend energy and use some replacement parts, but we will avoid losing any more water.

right.label: Watch and wait
right.description: Let’s save energy now and monitor the leak for the rest of the day.
right.sourceResponse: Let’s save energy now and monitor the leak for the rest of the day.

description: Our greenhouse can grow food, but it needs water and power.
sourceDescription:
The astronauts managed to set up a small greenhouse inside the base!
It is now possible to grow some vegetables, but the plants require water,
energy, and special care. The team is discussing whether to invest more 
resources into the cultivation.
imageCaption: Astronauts work beside a plant experiment.
imageAlt: Astronauts work beside a plant experiment.

left.label: Grow fresh food
left.description: We will use some of the resources to grow fresh food for the future.
left.sourceResponse: We will use some of the resources to grow fresh food for the future.

right.label: Use stored food
right.description: Let’s conserve water and energy by using the food we already have.
right.sourceResponse: Let’s conserve water and energy by using the food we already have.

description: We found ice underground! Use power to collect water?
sourceDescription:
During an exploration near the base, one of the vehicles identified
signs of ice hidden beneath the Martian surface! This ice could be 
an important source of water for the team. However, it will be 
necessary to use equipment to excavate it and convert it into
water suitable for consumption.
imageCaption: A map shows where ice may lie below the surface of Mars.
imageAlt: A map shows where ice may lie below the surface of Mars.

left.label: Dig for ice
left.description: We will invest energy in an attempt to obtain water for our reservoir.
left.sourceResponse: We will invest energy in an attempt to obtain water for our reservoir.

right.label: Use stored water
right.description: Let’s preserve resources and use only the water we already have.
right.sourceResponse: Let’s preserve resources and use only the water we already have.

description: A plant experiment could help us grow food. Use extra power?
sourceDescription:
The scientists at the base were given a special opportunity: to conduct 
an experiment studying plant growth on Mars! However, the laboratory 
requires additional energy to keep the equipment running during the experiment.
imageCaption: An astronaut works outside the space station.
imageAlt: An astronaut works outside the space station.

left.label: Run the experiment
left.description: Let’s invest energy in learning more about how to produce food on Mars.
left.sourceResponse: Let’s invest energy in learning more about how to produce food on Mars.

right.label: Save energy
right.description: Let’s conserve energy for the base’s essential needs.
right.sourceResponse: Let’s conserve energy for the base’s essential needs.

description: Food is running low. Should we serve smaller meals?
sourceDescription:
After a long day of work, the astronauts are ready for dinner. However, the crew has 
noticed that some food items are running out faster than expected. It is possible 
to prepare simpler meals and better control portion sizes.
imageCaption: Astronauts share a meal aboard the space station.
imageAlt: Astronauts share a meal aboard the space station.

left.label: Plan smaller meals
left.description: Let’s manage the available food better.
left.sourceResponse: Let’s manage the available food better.

right.label: Keep full meals
right.description: Astronauts need to maintain a good diet, and we do not want to reduce their meals.
right.sourceResponse: Astronauts need to maintain a good diet, and we do not want to reduce their meals.

description: The shelter has a crack. Use spare parts or local regolith?
sourceDescription:
During a routine inspection, an astronaut discovered a small crack
in the outer layer of the shelter. The team must repair the area before 
the base's protection is compromised.
imageCaption: The crew capsule of a space shuttle in orbit.
imageAlt: The crew capsule of a space shuttle in orbit.

left.label: Use spare parts
left.description: We will use replacement parts to fix the problem.
left.sourceResponse: We will use replacement parts to fix the problem.

right.label: Use regolith
right.description: We will use resources found on the surface to improve the shelter's protection.
right.sourceResponse: We will use resources found on the surface to improve the shelter's protection.

description: The air filter is getting full. Replace it or reduce work?
sourceDescription:
The base’s sensors indicated that the filter responsible for cleaning the air 
is becoming saturated. It needs to be replaced so that the crew can continue 
breathing suitable air.
imageCaption: An astronaut repairs air-cleaning equipment inside the space station.
imageAlt: An astronaut repairs air-cleaning equipment inside the space station.

left.label: Replace the filter
left.description: Replace the filter immediately. We will use a replacement part and perform maintenance.
left.sourceResponse: Replace the filter immediately. We will use a replacement part and perform maintenance.

right.label: Reduce lab work
right.description: Reduce laboratory activities and postpone the replacement.Let's try to reduce the amount of particles produced inside the base.
right.sourceResponse: Reduce laboratory activities and postpone the replacement.Let's try to reduce the amount of particles produced inside the base.

description: Water recycling has failed. Use backup equipment or wait?
sourceDescription:
The equipment that recovers water from crew waste has experienced a failure.
 Some of the water that would normally be reused cannot be recovered until the
 problem is resolved.
imageCaption: An astronaut services equipment behind a large panel.
imageAlt: An astronaut services equipment behind a large panel.

left.label: Use the backup
left.description: Use the backup system. We will expend energy to keep the recycling process running.
left.sourceResponse: Use the backup system. We will expend energy to keep the recycling process running.

right.label: Store waste and wait
right.description: Store the waste and wait for the repair. Let’s avoid using the damaged equipment.
right.sourceResponse: Store the waste and wait for the repair. Let’s avoid using the damaged equipment.

description: Air is escaping from a module! Repair it or use a quick patch?
sourceDescription:
A sensor has detected a small pressure loss in one of the base modules.
 It looks like air is escaping through an opening in the structure!
imageCaption: A crew member inspects the wall inside a spacecraft.
imageAlt: A crew member inspects the wall inside a spacecraft.

left.label: Isolate and repair
left.description: Isolate the compartment and repair the leak. We will protect the rest of the base.
left.sourceResponse: Isolate the compartment and repair the leak. We will protect the rest of the base.

right.label: Use a quick patch
right.description: Apply a temporary patch. We will try to prevent air loss while we arrange for a permanent repair.
right.sourceResponse: Apply a temporary patch. We will try to prevent air loss while we arrange for a permanent repair.

description: The antenna broke. Send an astronaut or inspect it with a rover?
sourceDescription:
A communication antenna installed outside the base has stopped working. 
An astronaut will need to go out to check the equipment and attempt to repair it.
imageCaption: Spacewalking astronauts work outside the space station.
imageAlt: Spacewalking astronauts work outside the space station.

left.label: Send an astronaut
left.description: Send an astronaut to carry out the repair. Communication could be quickly re-established.
left.sourceResponse: Send an astronaut to carry out the repair. Communication could be quickly re-established.

right.label: Use the rover
right.description: Use the exploration vehicle to inspect the antenna. We will avoid an immediate extravehicular activity, but the repair might take longer.
right.sourceResponse: Use the exploration vehicle to inspect the antenna. We will avoid an immediate extravehicular activity, but the repair might take longer.

description: The greenhouse lights broke. Use backup lights or wait?
sourceDescription:
The special lights in the greenhouse have stopped working. 
Without proper lighting, the plants will struggle to grow.
imageCaption: A plant habitat prototype glows under red lights.
imageAlt: A plant habitat prototype glows under red lights.

left.label: Use backup lights
left.description: Turn on the emergency lights. We’re going to use more energy to keep the plants illuminated.
left.sourceResponse: Turn on the emergency lights. We’re going to use more energy to keep the plants illuminated.

right.label: Wait for repairs
right.description: Wait for the main lamps to be repaired. We will save energy, but the plants will receive less light.
right.sourceResponse: Wait for the main lamps to be repaired. We will save energy, but the plants will receive less light.

description: Spots on our plants may be fungus. Remove them or treat them?
sourceDescription:
An astronaut noticed strange spots on some of the leaves in the plantation.
 The team suspects that a fungus is contaminating the plants.
imageCaption: Plants grow under purple lights on the space station.
imageAlt: Plants grow under purple lights on the space station.

left.label: Remove sick plants
left.description: Remove the contaminated plants. Let’s prevent the problem from spreading.
left.sourceResponse: Remove the contaminated plants. Let’s prevent the problem from spreading.

right.label: Treat the plants
right.description: Let’s try treating the plants. We will preserve the crop by using an appropriate treatment.
right.sourceResponse: Let’s try treating the plants. We will preserve the crop by using an appropriate treatment.

description: Some food got too warm. Throw it away or inspect each pack?
sourceDescription: One of the storage compartments experienced a temperature failure. Some food items may no longer be suitable for consumption.
imageCaption: An open can of food floats inside the space station.
imageAlt: An open can of food floats inside the space station.

left.label: Throw it away
left.description: Let's throw away the potentially spoiled food to keep the crew safe. We'll lose some food, but save water and energy.
left.sourceResponse: Let's throw away the potentially spoiled food to keep the crew safe. We'll lose some food, but save water and energy.

right.label: Check the packs
right.description: Let's carefully inspect the food packages to find out which ones are still safe to eat. We might save more food, but we'll need extra water and energy for the inspection.
right.sourceResponse: Let's carefully inspect the food packages to find out which ones are still safe to eat. We might save more food, but we'll need extra water and energy for the inspection.
